# International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA)

> The IAEA is the world's center for nuclear cooperation, promoting the peaceful use of atomic energy while ensuring nuclear safety, security, and safeguards globally.

The IAEA works with member states across 193 countries to advance nuclear science and technology for sustainable development, climate action, health, food security, and industrial applications. Led by Director-General Rafael Mariano Grossi, the agency maintains Vienna headquarters with regional offices worldwide.

## Nuclear Applications and Technology

- [Nuclear energy, safe use of nuclear power | IAEA](https://www.iaea.org/topics/energy): Nuclear energy for sustainable growth and climate change mitigation
- [Nuclear technology and applications | IAEA](https://www.iaea.org/topics/nuclear-technology-and-applications): Nuclear science technology transfer and peaceful member state assistance
- [Health care and diagnostics, nuclear medicine | IAEA](https://www.iaea.org/topics/health): Nuclear medicine, cancer treatment, and health diagnostics applications
- [Nuclear technologies for food and agriculture | IAEA](https://www.iaea.org/topics/food-and-agriculture): Nuclear agriculture with FAO for food security and crop improvement
- [Nuclear science and technology for industry | IAEA](https://www.iaea.org/topics/industry): Radiation technology and industrial applications for member states

## Safety, Security, and Environmental Protection

- [Nuclear safety and security | IAEA](https://www.iaea.org/topics/nuclear-safety-and-security): Global nuclear safety framework and radiation protection standards
- [Studying climate change with nuclear and isotopic techniques | IAEA](https://www.iaea.org/topics/climate-change): Nuclear techniques for climate monitoring and environmental protection
- [Environment | IAEA](https://www.iaea.org/topics/environment): Nuclear tools for environmental monitoring and remediation
- [Water: quality and availability assessment with isotopic techniques | IAEA](https://www.iaea.org/topics/water): Isotope hydrology for water quality and resource management

## Nuclear Science and Research

- [Nuclear science | IAEA](https://www.iaea.org/topics/nuclear-science): Nuclear science, research, and education for member state capacity
